Join us on a cinematic journey to Canaima National Park, where majestic tepui mountains meet mesmerizing cascading waterfalls.
Through this video, you will uncover the secrets of these ancient geological wonders, some of the oldest exposed rock surfaces on Earth, and witness the thriving ecosystems that shelter a multitude of unique plant and animal species.
